verdict.rationale: Fellow's own feature page says teams can record without a visible bot by capturing audio directly from the desktop across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Slack Huddles and in-person meetings. Its documented recording pipeline produces full, searchable transcripts. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the desktop capture client (setup, supported OSes, how it behaves in a call), explicit confirmation that external participants see no indicator, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing copy.

support.subject: As a founder, I can capture and transcribe meetings without a visible bot joining the call — audio is captured from my device so external participants see nothing extra

citations.quote: Fellow gives teams the flexibility to record with a visible bot or without one — capturing audio directly from the desktop across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Slack Huddles, and in-person meetings
Every conversation becomes searchable through a full transcript, giving your team instant access to past context whenever they need it.
Fellow records, transcribes, and summarizes every meeting across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Slack huddles with enterprise-grade security and human-level accuracy.
